## Summary

Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/csv/CSVFormatAgentTest.java` — a JUnit 4 test class (matching the project's JUnit 4.12 + `org.junit.Assert.*` static-import style used by the existing `CSVFormatTest`), covering only `CSVFormat`'s public API.

**Verification results:**
- `defects4j compile` → OK (main + tests)
- `java -cp "$(defects4j export -p cp.test)" org.junit.runner.JUnitCore org.apache.commons.csv.CSVFormatAgentTest` → **OK (92 tests)**
- Existing `CSVFormatTest` still green (55 tests) — no other files touched.

**Coverage (92 tests):**
- **Predefined formats & factories**: full property assertions for `DEFAULT`, `RFC4180`, `EXCEL`, `MYSQL`, `TDF`; `newFormat` minimal state; `newFormat`/`withDelimiter` rejecting `\r` and `\n`; `valueOf` returning the exact singletons and throwing `IllegalArgumentException` on an unknown name; `Predefined` enum.
- **`with*` builders**: delimiter, quote (set/disable/line-break/equal-to-delimiter), comment marker (set/disable/line-break/equal-to-quote), escape (set/disable/line-break/equal-to-delimiter), null string, quote mode (incl. `NONE` requires escape), record separator (char & String), and every boolean toggle (`IgnoreEmptyLines`, `IgnoreSurroundingSpaces`, `IgnoreHeaderCase`, `SkipHeaderRecord`, `TrailingDelimiter`, `Trim`, `AllowMissingColumnNames`, `AutoFlush`) asserted through their getters; immutability (originals unchanged, new instance every call).
- **Headers**: array defensive-copy, null/empty, duplicate rejection, from enum / null enum / empty enum, from `ResultSetMetaData` (via a `Proxy` stub) and null `ResultSet`/`ResultSetMetaData`, header comments with `toString` conversion, `withFirstRecordAsHeader`.
- **`equals`/`hashCode`/`toString`**: reflexivity, null & wrong-type, copy equality + hashCode, field-by-field discrimination (delimiter, quote mode, header, ignore-empty-lines), the fields `equals` deliberately ignores, and exact `toString` output for `DEFAULT` and `newFormat`.
- **`format(...)`**: empty, simple, custom delimiter, quoting of embedded delimiter, doubled embedded quote, raw output with no quote char, escape char + escaped newline, `QuoteMode` ALL/NON_NUMERIC/NONE, null handling with/without null string, MySQL escaping, and NPE on a null array.
- **`parse` / `print` / `printRecord` / `println` / `print(value,out,newRecord)` / `printer()` / `print(File|Path, Charset)`**: asserting the actual written/parsed content, header emission on printer construction, trailing-delimiter and no-separator edge cases, trim application, and `IllegalArgumentException` on null reader/appendable.
